## Analysis Questions Whether MongoDB's Customer Acquisition Costs Are Sustainable Against Its Platform Ambitions

CAC sustainability is a core lever in the enterprise software re-rating debate — if MDB is spending heavily to acquire customers who do not generate durable platform revenue, the growth-at-scale thesis weakens; this is worth tracking alongside MDB's next quarterly metrics.

- A published analysis raises concerns about whether MongoDB's customer acquisition cost (CAC) trajectory is sustainable over the long term
- The concern is framed relative to MDB's ambitions as a platform — implying current spend may not be converting at a rate that justifies the investment
- Specific CAC figures, growth rates, or benchmarks are not available from the headline
- Confidence is medium; directional read is cautionary on MDB's growth investment thesis
